channel.title: Torch Outlet
channel.description: Genuine Nitecore torches at about half the Australian retail price.

item.g:title: Nitecore MH23 Rechargeable Torch, 1800 Lumens
item.g:description: The brightest torch on our shelf, and one of the smallest. 1800 lumens from a body that weighs less than your phone. The MH23 runs a CREE XHP35 HD LED and throws a beam 294 metres. It charges by micro USB, so the lead in your ute or on your desk will do the job. It is rated IPX8 waterproof and comes in under 100 grams. Pocket it, clip it, forget it is there until you need to light up the whole back paddock.

item.g:title: Nitecore MH20GT Palm-Size Spotlight, 1000 Lumens, 362 m
item.g:description: A spotlight you can close your hand around. 1000 lumens pushed into a tight beam that reaches 362 metres. The GT in the name is the long-throw version. A CREE XP-L HI V3 LED and a deep reflector put the light where you point it, well past the far fence. It runs on a single 18650 cell and charges by micro USB without taking the battery out.

item.g:title: Nitecore MH12GT Rechargeable Torch, 1000 Lumens, 320 m
item.g:description: Everything people like about the MH12, with a tighter beam that reaches 320 metres. 1000 lumens from a CREE XP-L HI V3 LED. The 18650 battery and USB cable are in the box, so it works the day it lands. Charge it by micro USB from the wall, the car or a power bank. A solid one-torch answer for work and home.

item.g:title: Nitecore MH12 Rechargeable Torch, 1000 Lumens
item.g:description: The workhorse. 1000 lumens, a 3200mAh battery in the box, and a charge port on the torch. The MH12 uses a CREE XM-L2 U2 LED with a wider, more even beam than the GT model. It throws 232 metres, which covers most jobs you will ever point it at. It charges by micro USB from the ute, the wall or a laptop. Battery and cable are included.

item.g:title: Nitecore MH1C Rechargeable Torch, 600 Lumens
item.g:description: A pocket-sized rechargeable that does not ask you to buy anything else. Battery and cable are in the box. 600 lumens from a CREE XM-L2 LED in a body short enough for a jeans pocket. Charge it by micro USB. It is the cheapest way into a proper rechargeable torch on our shelf.

item.g:title: Nitecore P16 Precise Series Torch, 960 Lumens
item.g:description: A full-size tactical torch. 960 lumens, 289 metres of throw and a battery level indicator built in. The P16 runs a CREE XM-L2 T6 LED with 7 modes. It takes one 18650 rechargeable cell or two CR123 batteries, whichever you have on hand. The integrated power indicator tells you where the battery is at before you head out.

item.g:title: Nitecore P10GT Precise Series Torch, 900 Lumens
item.g:description: A compact tactical torch built for one hand. 900 lumens, 286 metres, and strobe on the tail switch when you need it. The P10GT uses a CREE XP-L HI V3 LED for a tight, long beam from a short body. It runs on one 18650 or two CR123 batteries. The tactical tail switch gives you instant on, and strobe is always ready.

item.g:title: Nitecore MT40GT Thrower Torch, 1000 Lumens, 618 m
item.g:description: The long-range torch. 1000 lumens focused into a beam that reaches 618 metres. A big reflector and a CREE XP-L HI LED do one job: put light a long way away. It runs 3 hours on high. Power comes from two 18650 cells or four CR123 batteries.

item.g:title: Nitecore MT22C Torch, 1000 Lumens, Infinitely Variable
item.g:description: No modes to click through. Twist the ring and the MT22C goes smoothly from 0.5 lumens to 1000. The rotary switch gives stepless brightness, so you set exactly the light you want. Low enough to read a map, high enough to light the yard. It uses a CREE XP-L HD V6 LED and runs on one 18650 or two CR123 batteries.

item.g:title: Nitecore MT20A Torch, 360 Lumens, 2 x AA
item.g:description: A proper torch that runs on two AA batteries. The kind you can buy at any servo at 2am. 360 lumens from a CREE XP-G2 LED, with a side switch and up to 170 hours on low. No charger, no special cells. Keep it in the glovebox or the kitchen drawer and it will be ready when the power goes out.

item.g:title: Nitecore EF1 Explosion-Proof Torch, 830 Lumens
item.g:description: An explosion-proof rated handheld torch for hazardous areas. 830 lumens from a single 18650 cell. The box is marked ATEX II 2 G Ex d IIC T6 Gb. In plain terms: a flameproof torch for Zone 1 gas atmospheres in surface industry. It is not a Group I underground mining rating. Before you buy, ask us for a photo of the marking and certificate number on the actual unit, and check them against your site's hazardous-area requirements. Use only the battery named in the manual.

item.g:title: Nitecore T5s Penlight, 70 Lumens, 1 x AAA
item.g:description: A pen-sized light that clips in a shirt pocket and runs on a single AAA battery. 70 lumens is the right amount for close work. Enough to see inside a switchboard or a throat, low enough not to blind you off a white wall. Up to 28 hours on low from one AAA.

item.g:title: Nitecore SENS Mini Torch, 170 Lumens, 1 x CR2
item.g:description: A keychain-sized torch that changes brightness by how you hold it. Nitecore calls it Active Dimming Technology. Point it down at a page and it dims. Lift it to look ahead and it brightens. 170 lumens from a single CR2 battery in a body small enough for a key ring.

item.g:title: Nitecore HC30 Headlamp, 1000 Lumens, 18650
item.g:description: 1000 lumens with both hands free. The HC30 is the headlamp for real work. A CREE XM-L2 U2 LED on a head that tilts 90 degrees, so the light goes where you are looking. Under the house, under the bonnet, on the night shift. It runs on one 18650 or two CR123 batteries, and lasts up to 400 hours on its ultralow setting.

item.g:title: Ferei HL20 AA High Intensity LED Headlamp
item.g:description: A work and camping headlamp that runs on AA batteries. No charger needed. Long runtime, a tilting head, and batteries you can buy at any servo. A good second headlamp for the camping box or the ute.

item.g:title: Nitecore EH1S Explosion-Proof Headlamp, Spot and Flood
item.g:description: The EH1 with two beams. A spot for distance and a flood for close work, in an explosion-proof rated headlamp. 260 lumens, USB rechargeable, IP68. The certification marking is printed on the lamp and on the box. Before you buy, ask us for a photo of the marking on the actual unit. Check it against your site's hazardous-area requirements.

item.g:title: Nitecore LR30 Camping Lantern, 205 Lumens, High CRI
item.g:description: A camp table lantern that makes food look like food. 205 lumens of high CRI light, all the way around. High CRI means colours look right, which matters when you are cooking, reading a map or sorting first aid gear. It charges by USB and has a magnetic base, so it sticks to the car, the canopy or the fridge.

item.g:title: Nitecore LR10 Pocket Camping Lantern, 250 Lumens
item.g:description: A lantern that folds flat into a pocket. 250 lumens of high CRI light with a magnet and a hanging hook. Natural-colour light for cooking, reading and working under the bonnet. It charges by USB, stands on its own, sticks to steel and hangs from its built-in hook.

item.g:title: Nitecore LA30 Bi-Fuel Camping Lantern, 250 Lumens
item.g:description: A rechargeable lantern that keeps going when the power does not. Run it on the built-in battery or drop in two AAs. 250 lumens with white and red light. Red keeps your night vision and does not pull in every bug in the campground. The base is magnetic. Charge it by USB when you can, feed it AA batteries when you cannot.

item.g:title: Nitecore LA10 Ultra Portable Camping Lantern, 135 Lumens
item.g:description: A tiny lantern that runs on one AA battery and sticks to anything steel. Extend the diffuser and it throws 135 lumens all around. Collapsed, it is about the size of a lipstick. Magnetic base, up to 23 hours on low. Tent light, tool-bag light, blackout light.

item.g:title: Nitecore TIP 2017 Keychain Light, 360 Lumens
item.g:description: 360 lumens that lives on your key ring. Metal body, built-in battery, charges from any USB port. Four brightness levels, a lockout mode so it does not switch on in your pocket, and up to 46 hours on low. It is the torch you will actually have on you. For the ute, the toolbox and the back door.

item.g:title: Nitecore TIP SS Stainless Steel Keychain Light, 360 Lumens
item.g:description: The TIP keychain light in stainless steel. Heavier in the hand and made for life near the coast. 360 lumens, four brightness levels and USB charging, in a stainless body that shrugs off salt air. Three finishes: Glacier, Tropical and Jet Black. Same light as the standard TIP. Tougher finish.

item.g:title: Nitecore TIP CU Copper Keychain Light, 360 Lumens
item.g:description: The collector's TIP. A solid copper body that develops its own patina the more you carry it. 360 lumens and USB charging, same as the standard TIP. Copper darkens and marks with use, so no two end up looking the same. Polish it back or let it age.

item.g:title: Nitecore TINI Keychain Light, 380 Lumens
item.g:description: Smaller than a car key and brighter than it has any right to be. 380 lumens at 11 grams. Four brightness levels plus SOS, a metal body and a built-in battery that charges by USB. It lives on the key ring and gets used every day.

item.g:title: Nitecore Tube UV 365nm Keychain UV Light
item.g:description: A 365nm UV light that weighs 10 grams and charges by USB. 365nm is the useful end of UV. It makes security features, stains and UV-reactive materials glow without washing them out in purple light. Check banknotes, find pet stains, cure UV resin and glue, and read security marks.

item.g:title: Nitecore TM28 Tiny Monster, 6000 Lumens, 655 m
item.g:description: The biggest light on our shelf. Four LEDs, 6000 lumens, a 655 metre beam and an OLED screen that tells you output, voltage and runtime. The TM28 runs four CREE XHP35 HI LEDs off four 18650 cells. The cells charge inside the torch from the mains adaptor in the box, so there is no separate charger to buy. Full 6000 lumen turbo needs high-drain cells. On ordinary 18650 cells turbo is 4500 lumens. Rated IPX8 and 414 grams before batteries.

item.g:title: Nitecore TM06S Tiny Monster, 4000 Lumens
item.g:description: 4000 lumens from a torch about the length of your palm. Four LEDs side by side for a wide wall of light out to 359 metres. The TM06S uses four CREE XM-L2 U3 LEDs and four 18650 cells. It is a flood of light more than a pencil beam, which is what you want for a yard, a shed or a campsite. Batteries are not in the box and it has no charge port, so you will need 18650 cells and a charger. Rated IPX8 and 266 grams before batteries.

item.g:title: Nitecore TM16 Searchlight, 4000 Lumens, 700 m
item.g:description: A handheld searchlight. 4000 lumens pushed 700 metres by four deep reflectors. The TM16 pairs four CREE XM-L2 U2 LEDs with a wide 89 mm head, so it has both output and reach. It runs on four 18650 cells. Batteries are not in the box and there is no charge port. Rated IPX8 and 506 grams before batteries.

item.g:title: Nitecore TM03 Tactical Torch, 2800 Lumens
item.g:description: 2800 lumens from one battery. The TM03 is a single-cell tactical torch with the output of a much bigger light. It uses a CREE XHP70 LED and a dedicated high-drain 18650 cell, which is in the box. Full output needs that dedicated cell. There is no charge port on the torch and no charger in the box, so you will need an 18650 charger. Rated IPX8, 213 grams.

item.g:title: Nitecore MH40GT Rechargeable Thrower, 1000 Lumens, 803 m
item.g:description: The longest beam we sell. 1000 lumens focused into a spot that reaches 803 metres, with the batteries and charger in the box. A CREE XP-L HI V3 LED sits in a deep 60 mm reflector. That is what turns 1000 lumens into 803 metres. Two 18650 cells are included and charge inside the torch. The charger is a mains adaptor with a barrel plug, not USB.

item.g:title: Nitecore P12 Tactical Torch, 1000 Lumens (2015 Version)
item.g:description: A compact tactical torch. 1000 lumens and a 232 metre beam from a body that weighs 88 grams. This is the 2015 version of the P12, with a CREE XM-L2 U2 LED. Tail switch for on and off, side switch for modes. It runs on one 18650 or two CR123 cells. Batteries are not included. On its lowest setting it runs for up to 520 hours.

item.g:title: Nitecore P15 Tactical Torch, 430 Lumens, 278 m
item.g:description: Built for reach, not flood. 430 lumens in a tight beam that carries 278 metres. The P15 uses a CREE XP-G2 LED and a deep reflector. It has four brightness levels plus strobe, SOS and beacon, and a power indicator. It runs on one 18650 or two CR123 cells and lasts up to 520 hours on its lowest setting.

item.g:title: Nitecore P16 TAC Tactical Torch, 1000 Lumens, 300 m
item.g:description: The tactical version of the P16. 1000 lumens, 300 metres, and a tail switch you can find with a gloved thumb. A CREE XM-L2 U3 LED, four brightness levels and three special modes. A spring-loaded mechanism inside protects the battery contact from hard knocks. It runs on one 18650 or two CR123 cells. Batteries are not included.

item.g:title: Nitecore T360 Clip-On Work Light, USB Rechargeable
item.g:description: A 20 gram light that clips to a cap, a pocket or a pack strap and turns all the way round to point where you need it. 45 lumens is the right amount for close work: reading, tying a knot, finding the keyhole. It sits in a rotating bracket with a clip, and a headband is included. The battery is built in and charges by micro USB. Rated IP65.

item.g:title: Ferei HL50 II Twin Head Headlamp, 2200 Lumens
item.g:description: A serious twin-head headlamp. 2200 lumens with a separate battery case and two 18650 cells in the pack. Brightness adjusts from 3 percent up to full. On the lowest setting the maker lists 143 hours of runtime, and 4.3 hours at full output. Rated IPX4 for rain. Ask us what is in the pack before you buy, because we are confirming whether a charger is included.
